blocks.text: Globe has been at the forefront of bringing digital innovation closer to Filipinos, from its early beginning in being the first digital network to pioneering mobile data adoption with Free Facebook. Globe then brought to life what then seemed impossible with customizable plans. This was followed by a series of connectivity firsts like 4G LTE, 5G and today’s Southeast Asia’s first Starlink satellite-to-mobile service. Now, the company is changing the game yet again by setting its sights on this millenia’s next technology leap: artificial intelligence (AI).
